name: Simple Layout
author: wssst
description: Clean and clear, with a full keyboard and command page; suits regular players; adds some mod hotkeys (updated from time to time); highly extensible (you can add combo keys like x+c to the hotkeys); control groups are clearly marked; if you know how you can extend it yourself; "the key styles use Bilibili XiaoluoFoxington's bedjava"

buttonList.text:
Announcement
1.2 update contents:

Added feature (long-press to close the action page) to hide keys; close the sub-key group first
Added some mod-adapted key groups; open them in the Full Keyboard hotkeys
Using a command from the command page will auto-close the command page
If you do not want this announcement every time, delete 'Announcement' from the control group
Key style reference: Bilibili XiaoluoFoxington's bedjava
Tap here for key special functions

Sub page
Long-press / hide all keys
Close action page

This introduces some extra key features.
The first row is where the key sits in the key group, the second row is the trigger/effect, and the third row is the key text
This key group is for adding your own hotkeys
To avoid key conflicts, some keys were changed; please go to key binds for the input (the text written is what's on the keyboard)
